status: post-outcome terrain-mediation diagnostic frozen after native collective outcome and before terrain-relative collective outcome
role: tests whether the native collective-persistence result can be explained by repeated use of terrain elevation

lane_A_natural_turnover.membership_rule: night pairs share zero tracked individual identities
lane_A_natural_turnover.primary_metric: common-horizontal conditional terrain-relative vertical overlap O_Z_given_XY
lane_A_natural_turnover.null: within every individual-night independently permute complete terrain-relative conditional vertical-profile vectors among that session's occupied 500-m cells
lane_A_natural_turnover.support_rule: observed mean O_Z_given_XY minus null mean > 0 and one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

dem.source: reuse the pinned SRTM DEM tile receipt from original terrain-relative 3D geometry
dem.interpolation: bilinear_hgt exactly as frozen in run_original_terrain_geometry_v1.py

claim_boundary: This is a post-outcome mediation diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
Persistence after DEM subtraction weakens simple terrain-elevation explanation but does not establish social or cognitive memory.
Stable canopy, resource, or other spatial environmental structure remains an alternative.
If the exact native turnover-pair counts change, stop rather than retune.
